en: Can you remember on which day God created humans? How were they created? The Chinese translation of “greed” is 婪. Do you notice any connection between the structure of the word “婪” (two trees and one woman) and the origin of sin?
zh: 讀完後能否記住，神是第幾天造人，如何造的？ 是否發現這個字“婪”和罪的由來有關聯?

en: Did anyone in the genealogies in chapter 5 get drowned by the flood? The Chinese translation of “ark” is 船. Does the structure of the word “船” (one boat and eight people) suggest a deeper meaning to you?
zh: 第五章家譜裡的人有沒有被洪水淹死的？ 你對這個字“船”有了更多的理解嗎？

en: What covenant did God make with Noah and his descendants, including you and me? When Babel is being translated from Hebrew into English, what is it also called? Or, to put it another way, there is a city in the Bible whose name comes from the same Hebrew word as Babel. Which city is it?
zh: 神和諾亞及後裔，包括你和我立了什麼約？ 巴別，從希伯來文翻譯成中文也稱作什麼，或者說聖經裡有一個城市的名字和巴別是同一個希伯來字，它是哪個城市？

en: What covenant did God make with Abram? Who came out to meet Abram with bread and wine?
zh: 神和亞伯蘭立了什麼約？ 誰拿酒和餅迎接亞伯蘭？

en: What new names did God give to Abram and Sarai, and what do they mean? Why did God destroy Sodom and Gomorrah?
zh: 神給亞伯蘭和撒萊的新名字叫什麼，有什麼含義？ 神為什麼要毀滅所多瑪和蛾摩拉？

en: How old was Abram when he left Haran? How old was he when Isaac was born? What does Jehovah-jireh mean? Was Isaac’s wife a Canaanite?
zh: 亞伯蘭出哈蘭時多大年齡？ 生以撒時多大年齡？ 耶和華以勒是什麼意思？ 以撒的妻子是迦南人嗎？

en: Why was Esau also called Edom? Comparing Genesis 26:7 with Genesis 26:16 and 26:28–29, what do you observe? When Jacob deceived Isaac to receive the blessing, what methods did Isaac use to determine whether he was really Esau? What does Bethel mean?
zh: 以掃為什麼又叫以東？ 對照創世記 26:7 與 26:16、26:28–29，你讀出了什麼？ 當雅各騙以撒要祝福時，以撒用哪些方法來確定他是不是以掃？ 伯特利是什麼意思？

en: Jacob deceived his father, who then deceived Jacob? How many years did Jacob serve Laban? Why was Jacob also called Israel?
zh: 雅各騙了父親，那誰騙了他？ 雅各服侍拉班多少年？ 雅各又被稱為以色列，為什麼？

en: Where did Jacob tell Esau he was going? But where did he actually go instead? How many sons did Jacob have? After Isaac died, where did Jacob live? Where did Esau live?
zh: 雅各對以掃說他會去什麼地方？ 但他實際卻去了另外什麼地方？ 雅各有多少個兒子？ 以撒死後，雅各住在哪裡？ 以掃住在哪裡？

en: For how much silver was Joseph sold by his brothers? After he was sold, who was with him so that everything he did prospered? Did Joseph refuse Potiphar’s wife because he was afraid of offending his master? At this time, Judah slept with someone he should not have—who was she? From whom did Joseph’s ability to interpret dreams come?
zh: 約瑟被哥哥們賣了多少銀子？ 被賣之後，誰與他同在，使他百事順利？ 約瑟不從波提乏妻子的誘惑，是因為他怕得罪他的主人嗎？ 此時猶大卻和一個他不應該同寢的人同寢，她是誰？ 約瑟解夢的能力出於誰？

en: How old was Joseph when he governed the whole land of Egypt? When they first went to Egypt to buy grain, how many sons did Jacob send? Whom did Joseph keep in custody while the other brothers returned to bring their youngest brother? In whose bag was the lost cup found? Who was willing to become Joseph’s slave in place of another?
zh: 約瑟治理埃及全地時多大年齡？ 第一次到埃及買糧時，雅各派了幾個兒子？ 約瑟把誰囚下，讓其餘的哥哥回去把他們的小弟弟帶來？ 失落的杯是在誰的袋子裡被發現的？ 是誰願意代替他人做約瑟的奴僕？

en: Who do you think sent Joseph to Egypt? Who would go down to Egypt with Jacob and surely bring him back up again? How many people from Jacob’s family came to Egypt in total? How old was Jacob when he went down to Egypt? How many years did Jacob live? Which of Jacob’s sons received a double portion?
zh: 你認為是誰差約瑟去了埃及？ 誰要和雅各一同下埃及去，也必定帶他上來？ 雅各家來到埃及的共有多少人？ 雅各下埃及時多大年齡？ 雅各平生的年日是多少？ 雅各兒子中誰多得一份？

en: Which son received the greatest blessing from Jacob? After Jacob died, was he buried in Egypt? After his father’s death, did Joseph intend to repay his brothers for their evil deeds? Before his death, how did Joseph ask the Israelites to deal with his bones?
zh: 雅各給哪個兒子的祝福最好？ 雅各死後是葬在埃及嗎？ 約瑟在父親死後是否要報復他哥哥們的惡行？ 約瑟臨死前要以色列的子孫如何處理他的骸骨？

en: What are the names of the two store cities? Did Pharaoh command all his people to throw the Hebrew boys or girls into the Nile? What does the name “Moses” mean? Who is Moses’ wife? With whom did the God remember His covenant? What is the God’s name? What are the two signs the LORD told Moses to perform?
Does Pharaoh know the LORD? Could the water turn into blood? Could the dust turn into gnats? How did Pharaoh’s heart react after each sign? Could the Egyptian magicians’ secret arts stop God’s signs?

Why did the LORD raise Pharaoh up? After the hail and locusts, was anything green left in Egypt? When total darkness covered all Egypt for three days, where was there light? On which day is the Passover? What sign did the LORD see that caused Him to pass over? How many years did the Israelites live in Egypt in total?

Whose bones did Moses take with him? Who led Israel by day with a pillar of cloud and by night with a pillar of fire? What was between the armies of Egyptian and Israel? Did Israel cross the Red Sea by boat? Whose right hand was majestic in power, shattered the enemy, and the earth swallowed them? Could the bitter water become sweet? What did the manna look like? What were its color and taste? How many years did the Israelites eat manna?

Could water flow from a rock? What does Jehovahnissi mean? (This is the KJV name; it may differ in NIV.) When did Israel arrive at the Desert of Sinai? What kind of treasured possession, kingdom, and nation did the LORD want the Israelites to be? Apart from the LORD, can there be other gods?

For a Hebrew servant, in which year shall he go free? How should someone who sacrifices to any god other than the LORD, be treated? In which year should the land lie unploughed and unused? Three times a year, which festivals should be celebrated? What is the evidence of the covenant?

Where were the tablets of the covenant law to be placed? Where did the LORD speak with Moses about everything He wanted Moses to command the Israelites? What was to be placed on the table at all times? Was the lampstand made of bronze? What was the curtain to separate? Where was the Ark of the Covenant to be placed? Was the altar covered with gold? Who was to serve the LORD as priests? On what was “HOLY TO THE LORD” engraved?

Where was the bull for the sin offering to be slaughtered? Who would dwell among the Israelites and be their God? How often was Aaron to make atonement on the horns of the altar? How much was each person to give as atonement money? When Aaron and his sons entered the tent of meeting, were they to wash their hands and feet? What was the sacred anointing oil used for? From whom did Bezalel receive wisdom to do all the work of the tent of meeting? After the Israelites made the golden calf and the LORD said he would destroy them, who pleaded with the LORD on their behalf?

Did Moses see the LORD’s face or back? What name did the LORD proclaim? Can the Israelites make a covenant with the Canaanites? When did Moses cover his face with a veil and when did he remove it? Were the offerings the Israelites offered to the LORD voluntary or forced? Were the offerings sufficient?

Where are the four gold rings on the Ark placed? How much gold, silver, and bronze did the Israelites dedicate for the sanctuary? According to whose command was all the work on the tabernacle completed? How long was it from leaving Egypt until the tabernacle was set up?

Why are burnt offerings to be presented? What kinds of livestock or birds can be used for a burnt offering? What must the grain offering be seasoned with, and what must not be included? How do the animals for the fellowship offering differ from those for the burnt offering? When someone sins unintentionally by doing something the LORD commanded not to be done, what offering is required?
zh: 為什麼要獻燔祭？ 什麼牲畜或鳥可以用做燔祭？ 獻為素祭的供物都要用什麼調和，而不可有什麼？ 獻為平安祭的牲畜和燔祭的有什麼不同？ 在耶和華所吩咐不可行的什麼事上，誤犯了罪，要獻什麼祭？

en: Is failing to testify truthfully a sin? If so, what offering is to be brought to seek forgiveness? Is lying a sin? Is the fire on the altar allowed to go out? Can Aaron and his sons eat what is left of the grain offering? What about the grain offering presented for the priests themselves? Which two offerings are governed by the same law? If the offering is for thanksgiving, what kind of offering is brought? When sacrifices are offered to ordain Aaron and his sons as priests, what is burned outside the camp?
zh: 沒有如實地做見證，是不是罪？ 如果是，應該獻什麼祭求赦免？ 說謊是不是罪？ 壇上的火可以熄滅嗎？ 素祭所剩下的，亞倫和他的子孫可以吃嗎？ 為祭司自己所獻的素祭呢？ 哪兩個祭是一個條例？ 若為感謝，應該獻什麼祭？ 膏亞倫和他兒子為祭司而獻祭時，什麼被火燒在營外？

en: When Aaron offered the sin offering, burnt offering, and fellowship offering and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people, in what year, month, and day after Israel came out of Egypt did this occur? Why were Nadab and Abihu put to death? Were the Israelites allowed to eat pork? On which day after birth was a boy to be circumcised?
zh: 亞倫獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，耶和華的榮光向眾民顯現時，是以色列出埃及後第幾年幾月幾日？ 拿答、亞比戶為什麼被燒死？ 以色列人可以吃豬肉嗎？ 男孩生下來第幾天要行割禮？

en: If a person was unclean, where was he to live? Who was responsible for determining whether a person or a garment was clean or unclean? Did a person seeking cleansing from uncleanness need to bring offerings? Could a house be affected by a defiling skin disease? On which day was the Day of Atonement?
zh: 人若不潔淨，他要住在哪裡？ 誰來確定人或衣物潔淨與否？ 不潔淨、求潔淨的人需要獻祭嗎？ 房子有可能染大痲瘋病嗎？ 贖罪日是哪一天？

en: Was it permitted to eat blood? Can blood atone for sin? Were the Israelites allowed to follow the practices of the Egyptians or the Canaanites? If not, how were they to live? Which verse from Leviticus 18 is quoted in the book of Galatians? Was it permitted to show favoritism to the poor? Who quoted “Love your neighbor as yourself” in the New Testament? If an Israelite sacrificed his children to Molek, what should be done? If an Israelite sacrifices their children to Molek, what should the people of the land do?
zh: 吃血可以嗎？ 血可以贖罪嗎？ 可以效法埃及人或迦南人的行為嗎？ 如果不可以，該如何做？ 利未記18章哪一節經文在加拉太書被引用？ 可以偏袒窮人嗎？ 誰曾在新約裡引用過「愛人如己」？ 如果以色列人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地人應該如何做？

en: Who is considered the chief among the people? Note: You can easy to find answer in KJV. In the NIV, the chief idea is implied rather than stated. What is referred to as the food of God? Can a descendant of Aaron who has a defiling skin disease eat the sacred offerings? When is the Festival of Weeks (Pentecost) celebrated? On which day is a memorial proclaimed with trumpet blasts? When is the Festival of Tabernacles celebrated? How is a person who blasphemes the name of the LORD to be punished?
zh: 誰在民中為首？ 什麼是神的食物？ 亞倫後裔長大痲瘋的可吃聖物嗎？ 五旬節是什麼時候？ 哪一天吹角作紀念？ 住棚節是什麼時候？ 褻瀆耶和華名的，如何處置？

en: How often is the Year of Jubilee to be celebrated? Are Israelites allowed to charge interest when lending to one another? If the Israelites violate the LORD’s covenant, will the LORD forget the covenant He has made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob? How long a period of time does the book of Leviticus cover?
zh: 多少年才有一次禧年？ 以色列人之間借錢可以取利嗎？ 如果以色列人背棄了耶和華的約，耶和華會不會忘記與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約？ 利未記所經歷的時間有多久？

en: How did the LORD instruct Moses to count the Israelite army? How many tribes were counted? What was the total number of people? Were the Levites included, and why or why not? Where was the Levite camp located? How were the Levites counted? How many were there? Which tribe took the place of the firstborn of Israel? How many Levites performed the carrying work in the tabernacle,that is,the tent of meeting?
zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西數點以色列軍隊？ 被數點的有多少支派？ 共有多少人？ 包括利未支派嗎？ 為什麼？ 利未營的位置在哪裡？ 如何數點利未人？ 共有多少人？ 哪個支派代替以色列頭生的？ 利未支派在會幕裡做抬物之工的共有多少人？

en: Why must the unclean go outside the camp? What does Nazirite mean? How should Aaron and his sons bless the Israelites? On the days the altar is anointed, how many days do the leaders offer their offerings? Are the offerings the same each day? Which tribe is set apart from the Israelites for the LORD?
zh: 不潔淨的為什麼要到營外去？ 拿細耳是什麼意思？ 亞倫和他的兒子應該如何為以色列人祝福？ 用膏抹壇的日子，眾首領獻供物多少天？ 每天獻的一樣嗎？ 哪個支派從以色列人中分別出來，歸耶和華？

en: If someone is unclean due to contact with a dead body and cannot celebrate the Passover, is there other day to celebrate it? Does the Israelites’ journey or camping relate to the cloud over the tabernacle? On what day did the Israelites leave the Desert of Sinai? What does Moses say whenever the ark sets out? What does he say whenever it comes to rest? What does Kibroth Hattaavah mean? Who began to talk against Moses? Who is described as extremely humble?
zh: 若有人因死屍不潔淨不能守逾越節，還有其他的日子可守逾越節嗎？ 以色列人起行或安營和帳幕上的雲彩有關係嗎？ 哪一天以色列人離開西奈的曠野？ 約櫃前行時，摩西說什麼？ 停住時，說什麼？ 基博羅哈他瓦是什麼意思？ 誰毀謗摩西？ 誰為人極其謙和？

en: From where did the twelve men set out to explore the land of Canaan? How many days did they spend exploring? How many spread a bad report? How did the whole congregation react after hearing the report? For how many years will the Israelites wander in the wilderness? Whose body will lie in the wilderness? Who will be allowed to enter the land of Canaan? What do you learn from Numbers 14:39-45? Do foreigner and native-born have the same laws and regulations? What position did Korah and his followers try to get? How did they die? How was the plague stopped?
zh: 十二個探子從哪裡出發去窺探迦南地？ 探子去了多少天？ 有幾個報惡信？ 全會眾聽後，如何反應？ 以色列人要在曠野飄流多少年？ 誰的屍首必倒在這曠野？ 誰才能進入迦南地？ 從民數記14：39—45，你學到了什麼？ 寄居和本地是否有一樣的條例和典章？ 可拉一黨要求什麼職任？ 他們是如何死的？ 瘟疫是如何止住的？

en: Whose staff will sprout? Which firstborn must be redeemed? Which firstborn cannot be redeemed? What fraction of Israel’s produce is given to the LORD as a wave offering? What is the ashes of the red heifer used for? Where did Miriam die? What did Moses and Aaron do wrong at the waters of Meribah? Where did Aaron die?
zh: 誰的杖發了芽？ 什麼頭生的總要贖出來？ 什麼頭生的必不可贖？ 以色列出產的幾分之一是獻給耶和華為舉祭的？ 紅母牛的灰用來做什麼？ 米利暗死在哪裡？ 在米利巴水，摩西和亞倫做錯了什麼？ 亞倫死在哪裡？

en: What did Moses make and put it up on a pole? Whoever was bitten by a snake would live by looking at it? In the New Testament, who said he would be lifted up in the same way so that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life? Why did the king of Moab summon Balaam, and why did he refuse the first time but go the second time? Who caused Balaam’s donkey to speak? The king of Moab summoned Balaam to curse Israel, but he blessed Israel instead. From whom did this blessing come?
zh: 摩西製造了什麼，掛在桿子上？ 凡被蛇咬的，一望它就活了？ 在新約，誰說自己也必照樣被舉起來，叫一切信他的都得永生？ 摩亞王召巴蘭，為什麼他第一次沒去，而第二次去了？ 誰叫巴蘭的驢開口？ 摩亞王召巴蘭詛咒以色列人，但他卻祝福以色列人，這祝福到底來自誰？

en: In Numbers 25, what caused the plague? What caused the plague to stop? On the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, how many Israelites were counted? Compared to the count in the wilderness of Sinai, which tribe increased the most? Which tribe decreased the most? Who were counted in both censuses? If a man dies without a son, to whom does his inheritance go? Why was Moses not allowed to enter Canaan? In Numbers 28, for what occasions did God instruct Moses to present the offerings?
zh: 在民數記25，什麼事情導致瘟疫發生？ 什麼事情使瘟疫止息？ 在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約旦河邊，以色列人中被數的共有多少人？ 和西奈曠野所數的比較，哪個支派人數增加最多？ 哪個支派人數減少最多？ 曾被兩次數點的是誰？ 人若死了沒有兒子，他的產業歸誰？ 為什麼摩西不能進迦南？ 在民數記28，神曉諭摩西什麼時候要獻祭？

en: In Numbers 29, for what occasions did God instruct Moses to present the offerings? If a man makes a vow to the LORD or takes an oath to bind himself by a pledge, can he break his word? Why did they fight against the Midianites? Why was Balaam killed? How is Balaam described in the New Testament? Do those who did not go to war share in the spoils? Do the Levites have a share? Which tribes asked for the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance?
zh: 在民數記29，神曉諭摩西什麼時候要獻祭？ 人若向耶和華許願或起誓，要約束自己，可以食言嗎？ 為什麼要和米甸人打仗？ 為什麼殺了巴蘭？ 新約裡如何描述巴蘭？ 打仗所得的擄物，沒出去打仗的有份嗎？ 利未人有份嗎？ 哪幾個支派要得約旦河東的地為產業？

en: Think again: when the king of Moab summoned Balaam, why did Balaam go the second time? How many places did the Israelites camp at from leaving Egypt until entering Canaan? After entering Canaan, what happens if the inhabitants are not driven out? Into how many tribes was the land of Canaan divided as inheritance? How many cities did the Levites receive? How many of these were cities of refuge? What is the purpose of the cities of refuge? Can a daughter who receives an inheritance in one of the Israelite tribes marry someone from another tribe?
zh: 再想一想,摩亞王召巴蘭,巴蘭為什麼第二次去了？ 以色列出埃及到進迦南前，走過多少站？ 進迦南後，倘若不趕出那地的居民，會如何？ 迦南地分給多少個支派為產業？ 利未人分到多少座城？ 其中有幾座逃城？ 逃城有什麼用處？ 凡在以色列支派中得了產業的女子可以嫁給別的支派人為妻嗎？

en: In which year, month, and day after the exodus did Moses proclaim the law in Moab east of the Jordan? To whom does judgment belong? Were the women and the men under twenty years of age counted in the Desert of Sinai? Were they allowed to enter Canaan? To whom had the LORD given the hill country of Seir as an inheritance? To whom had He given Ar? How many kings did Israel defeat east of the Jordan under Moses’ leadership, and who were they? Who was appointed to succeed Moses and lead Israel into Canaan? Were the Israelites allowed to add to or subtract from the commands the LORD gave them?
zh: 摩西在約旦河東的摩押地講律法時是出埃及第幾年幾月幾日？ 審判是屬乎誰？ 婦人和二十歲以內的男丁在西奈曠野被數點了嗎？ 他們可以進入迦南嗎？ 耶和華已將西珥山賜給誰為業？ 亞珥賜給誰為業？ 摩西帶領以色列在約旦河東擊殺了幾個王？ 他們是誰？ 誰要接替摩西帶領以色列進入迦南？ 耶和華吩咐以色列的話，他們可以加添或刪減嗎？

en: Is idolatry permitted? Who will be blessed by honoring their father and mother? What is the first commandment of the law? Which seven nations were Israel commanded to destroy completely when entering Canaan? Since those nations were more than Israel, how could Israel drive them out? Who used words from Deuteronomy chapter 8 to resist the devil’s temptation? Why did the LORD humble and test the Israelites in the wilderness?
zh: 拜偶像可以嗎？ 孝敬父母會使誰得福？ 律法的第一誡命是什麼？ 進入迦南，要將哪七國的民滅絕淨盡？ 那七國的民比以色列更多，以色列人怎能趕出他們呢？ 誰用申命記第八章的經文抵擋魔鬼的試探？ 耶和華為什麼要苦練和試驗以色列人？

en: Was it because of Israel’s righteousness that the LORD brought them into Canaan? How many periods of forty days and forty nights did Moses spend with the LORD? According to Deuteronomy chapter 10, what kind of God is the LORD? On which mountain were the blessings to be proclaimed? On which mountain were the curses to be proclaimed? After entering Canaan, were the Israelites allowed to offer sacrifices wherever they pleased?
zh: 耶和華領以色列人進迦南是因為他們的義嗎？ 摩西和耶和華在一起共有幾個四十晝夜？ 申命記第十章告訴我們耶和華是怎樣的一位神？ 祝福的話陳明在什麼山上？ 詛咒的話陳明在什麼山上？ 以色列進迦南後，可以在自己所看中的各處獻祭嗎？

en: If a prophet performs a sign or wonder and then entices you to follow other gods, what must you do? According to the law, is the pig clean? How often was the Year for Canceling Debts to be observed? What is the Festival of Weeks also called? What is the Festival of Tabernacles also called? Which three annual festivals required all Israelite men to appear before the LORD?
zh: 如果有先知行個神蹟，然後引誘你去拜耶和華以外的神，你該如何辦？ 按照律法，豬是潔淨的嗎？ 多久有一次豁免年？ 七七節也稱謂什麼節？ 住棚節也稱謂什麼節？ 一年哪三個節日要朝見耶和華？

en: How many witnesses were required to establish guilt in cases of breaking the law? Once Israel had a king in Canaan, was he allowed to make the people return to Egypt? Why was the king required to read the Book of the Law all the days of his life? God promised to raise up a prophet like Moses, who is this prophet? Under what circumstances were three additional cities of refuge to be added? Which cities could make peace with Israel and serve them?
zh: 如果有人違背了律法犯了罪，需要至少幾個見證人才能定案？ 進了迦南有了王，王可以帶百姓回埃及嗎？ 為什麼王要平生誦讀律法書？ 神要興起一位先知像摩西，他是誰？ 什麼情況下，可以再添三座逃城？ 哪些國民以外的城可以和以色列人和好，為以色列人效勞、服事？

en: Which son was entitled to receive a double share of the inheritance? How was a stubborn and rebellious son to be punished? After someone guilty of a capital offense was put to death, on what was the body hung? According to the law, how were the adulterer and the adulteress to be punished? Were shrine prostitutes or male shrine prostitutes permitted in Israel? If a divorced and remarried woman became single again, could her first husband marry her again? Were Israelites allowed to strip a vineyard bare of all its grapes?
zh: 哪個兒子會多分一份產業？ 如何懲治頑梗悖逆的兒子？ 人犯了死罪被治死後，掛在什麼上？ 按照律法，如何懲治姦夫淫婦？ 在以色列，可以有妓女或孌童嗎？ 被休的再嫁婦人成為單身時，休她的前夫可以再娶她為妻嗎？ 可以摘盡葡萄園的果子嗎？

en: Was the punishment of flogging the wicked allowed to exceed forty lashes? What does the phrase “the family of the unsandaled” mean? Whom did Israel declare to be their God? Who declared Israel to be his people? After crossing the Jordan, where were the words of the law to be written, and on what? If Israel was scattered among all the nations of the world, it must have been because…?
zh: 責打惡人，可以超過四十下嗎？ 脫鞋之家是什麼意思？ 以色列認誰為他們的神？ 誰認以色列為他的子民？ 過了約旦河後，要在什麼地方將律法抄寫在什麼上？ 如果以色列人在天下萬國中被拋來拋去，那一定是…？

en: If someone hears the words of this curse and still boasts in his heart, saying, ‘…’, the LORD will not be willing to forgive him; and from where will the LORD blot out his name? Which places were overthrown together with Sodom in the LORD’s fierce anger, and in which chapter of Genesis are they mentioned? Before Israel entered Canaan, who already knew the intentions of their hearts? In the Song of Moses, what name of the LORD is proclaimed? How does the LORD shield, care for and guard Israel? Who alone is God, who puts to death, and who gives life? Are the words of the law meaningless or irrelevant to Israel? Which verses from Deuteronomy 32 are quoted in the book of Romans?
zh: 聽見這詛咒的話，心裡仍自誇說「……」，耶和華必不饒恕他；耶和華又要從哪裡塗抹他的名？ 和所多瑪一同被耶和華在憤怒中傾覆的還有哪些地方，創世記哪一章同時提到了它們？ 以色列未進迦南以先，誰都知道他們心中的意念？ 在摩西的歌中，耶和華的名是什麼？ 耶和華如何環繞,看顧,保護以色列人？ 唯有誰是神，誰使人死，誰使人活？ 律法的話是不是虛空、與以色列無關的事？ 羅馬書引用申命記三十二章哪幾節經文？

en: Comparing the blessings of Jacob and Moses, which tribe received a better blessing than before? How old was Moses when he died, where did he die, and does anyone know the location of his grave? Was there a dispute over the body of Moses? Now that we have finished reading the Pentateuch and know that the law was given through Moses, through whom did grace and truth come?
zh: 比較雅各和摩西給以色列人的祝福，哪個支派得到了比以前更好的祝福？ 摩西死時多大年齡，死在何地，有人知道他的墳墓嗎？ 為摩西的屍首有過爭辯嗎？ 現在我們就讀完了摩西五經，知道了律法本是藉著摩西傳的，那麼恩典和真理 ，都是由誰來的呢？

en: What did the LORD refer to Moses? What did the LORD command Joshua to meditate on day and night, and why? Did the people of Jericho know that the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt and across the Red Sea, and were they afraid? Who saved the two spies of Israel? When crossing the Jordan River, what were the priests carrying, and did they cross by boat? What was the meaning of the twelve stones set up on the west side of the Jordan River? In which year, month, and day after the Exodus did the Israelites come up from the Jordan River and camp at Gilgal?
zh: 耶和華稱摩西為他的什麼人？ 耶和華要約書亞晝夜思想什麼，為什麼？ 耶利哥人知道耶和華帶以色列出埃及、過紅海等事嗎？ 他們有沒有驚慌？ 誰救了以色列的兩個探子？ 過約旦河時，祭司抬著什麼？ 他們是坐船過去的嗎？ 約旦河西的十二塊石頭是什麼意思？ 以色列出埃及第幾年、幾月、幾日從約旦河上來，就在吉甲？

en: What does the name Gilgal mean? In which year, month, and day after the Exodus did the manna from heaven cease? Were the walls of Jericho brought down by cannons or by explosives? If not, how did the walls collapse? After Jericho was captured, whose household alone was spared? Why were the men of Ai able to kill thirty-six Israelites? Why were the Israelites able, a few days later, to destroy all the people of Ai? On Mount Ebal, what did the Israelites do according to what Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded?
zh: 吉甲是什麼意思？ 出埃及後第幾年、幾月、幾日天上的嗎哪就止住了？ 耶利哥的城牆是被大炮轟或炸藥炸而塌陷的嗎？ 如果不是，它是如何塌陷的？ 耶利哥被奪取後，只有誰一家被救？ 為什麼艾城的人能擊殺以色列三十六人？ 幾日後，為什麼以色列人又能殺滅艾城所有的人？ 在以巴路山上，以色列人照耶和華的僕人摩西所吩咐的做了什麼？

en: Why were the Israelites deceived by the Hivites of Gibeon and made a treaty with them? Was the day on which Israel struck down the Amorites at Gibeon longer than other days? Which were more in number: those killed by the LORD with great hailstones, or those killed by Israel with the sword? Who fought for Israel? Did Joshua fail to carry out anything that the LORD had commanded Moses? How many kings did Joshua and the Israelites defeat west of the Jordan River?
zh: 為什麼以色列人會被基遍的希未人所欺騙，與他們講和立約？ 以色列人在基遍擊殺亞摩利人的那一天是否比其他日子長？ 被耶和華降下大冰雹打死的，和被以色列人用刀殺死的，哪一個更多？ 誰為以色列爭戰？ 凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，約書亞有沒有一樣懈怠不去遵行的？ 約書亞和以色列人在約旦河西擊殺了多少個王？

en: Which tribes settled east of the Jordan River? In which year after entering Canaan did Eleazar and Joshua allot the land of Canaan to the Israelites? Who received Hebron as an inheritance, and why? Which tribe received land in the far south? Where did the Canaanites live whom the tribe of Ephraim failed to drive out?
zh: 哪幾個支派住在約旦河東？ 以利亞撒和約書亞分配迦南地給以色列人時，是他們進入迦南的第幾年？ 誰得了希伯崙為產業？ 為什麼？ 哪一個支派所得之地是在最南邊？ 以法蓮支派沒有趕出住在哪裡的迦南人？

en: Where was the Tent of Meeting set up? Which tribe was located between Judah and the descendants of Joseph? Which tribe’s inheritance was located within the territory of Judah? What were the names of the six cities of refuge?
zh: 會幕設立在哪裡？ 哪一個支派位於猶大與約瑟子孫之間？ 哪一個支派的地業是在猶大人的地業中間？ 六座逃城的名字是什麼？

en: How many cities did the Levitical priests receive, and within the territories of which tribes were they located? Did any of the good promises the LORD made to Israel fail to come true? Who said that which two tribes would be divided and scattered within the house of Jacob? What was the name of the altar built by the two and a half tribes east of the Jordan, and what did it mean? Who sent the hornet to drive out the two Amorite kings before Israel? For what purpose did Joshua set up a large stone under the oak near the sanctuary of the LORD at Shechem?
zh: 利未人的祭司得了幾座城？ 分布在哪幾個支派的地業中？ 耶和華應許賜福給以色列的話有沒有落空？ 誰曾說要把哪兩個支派分散在雅各家中？ 約旦河東兩個半支派所築的壇叫什麼名字？ 它的意思是什麼？ 誰打發黃蜂將亞摩利的兩個王從以色列人面前趕出去？ 約書亞在示劍地橡樹下、耶和華聖所旁立了一塊大石頭，是為了什麼？

en: Did the tribe of Benjamin drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem? What does Bokim mean, and why was it called that? After Joshua and his generation died, did the later generations know the LORD? Why did the LORD no longer drive out the remaining nations after Joshua’s death? Who defeated Cushan-Rishathaim? What was the name of the Moabite king whom Ehud killed? Which woman did the LORD deliver Sisera into the hands of?
zh: 便雅憫有沒有趕出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人？ 波金是什麼意思？ 為什麼？ 約書亞和他同世代的人死後，他們以後的世代知不知道耶和華？ 約書亞死的時候所剩下的各族，耶和華不再趕出，為什麼？ 誰戰勝了古珊利薩田？ 以笏刺死的摩押王名字叫什麼？ 耶和華將西西拉交在哪個婦人手裡？

en: Who was with Gideon so that he would strike down the Midianites as one man? What does “Jehovah‑Shalom” mean, and what is its origin? (This is the KJV name; it may differ in the NIV.) How many men did Gideon lead to defeat the vast army of the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the eastern peoples? What did Gideon make and set up, and how did it become a snare to Gideon and his family?
zh: 誰與基甸同在，他就必擊打米甸人，如擊打一人一樣？ 耶和華沙龍是什麼意思？ 它的來由是什麼？ 基甸帶領多少人打敗了米甸人、亞瑪力人及東方聯軍這支極多的軍隊？ 基甸製造和設立了什麼？ 這就作了基甸和他全家的網羅？

en: Who killed his seventy brothers, and was his evil repaid? Why did the LORD’s anger burn against Israel, so that He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites? Do you think the vow Jephthah made to the LORD was good? Why did the Ephraimites threaten to burn down Jephthah’s house over his head, and do you think they were right?
zh: 誰殺了自己弟兄七十個人？ 他的惡有沒有受到報應？ 為什麼耶和華的怒氣向以色列發作，把他們交在非利士人和亞捫人的手中？ 耶弗他向耶和華許的願，你覺得好嗎？ 為什麼以法蓮人要用火燒耶弗他和他的房屋？ 你覺得他們對嗎？

en: What name did the angel of the LORD give to Manoah? What does the riddle “Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet” mean, and how did the Philistines learn the answer? How many Philistines did Samson kill with the jawbone of a donkey? What is the origin of the spring En Hakkore? Where did Samson’s strength come from? Did Samson kill more people at his death than during his lifetime?
zh: 耶和華的使者告訴瑪挪亞他的名是什麼？ 謎語「吃的從吃者出來；甜的從強者出來」是什麼意思？ 非利士人是如何知道謎底的？ 參孫用驢腮骨擊殺了多少非利士人？ 泉水隱哈歌利的由來是什麼？ 參孫的力氣來自哪裡？ 參孫死時所殺的人是否比他活著時所殺的更多？

en: Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household gods and installed one of his sons as his priest. Was this in accordance with the LORD’s law? According to the law, could Jonathan, the grandson of Moses, serve as a priest? What do Judges 17, 18, 19, and 21 repeatedly say that Israel did not have? The wicked acts of the men of Gibeah remind you of which city? Was Benjamin right to refuse to hand over the wicked men of Gibeah to be put to death? What did Israel not have in those days; everyone did as they saw fit?
zh: 米迦有神堂和神像，並派他兒子作祭司，符合耶和華的律法嗎？ 按照律法，摩西的孫子約拿單可以作祭司嗎？ 士師記17、18、19、21章反覆提到以色列沒有什麼？ 基比亞城中匪徒的惡行讓你想到哪座城？ 便雅憫不肯將基比亞的匪徒交出來治死他們，對嗎？ 以色列中沒有什麼，各人任意而行？

en: What did Ruth say that made Naomi realize she was determined to follow her back to Israel? Ruth left her father and mother and her homeland and came to live with a people she did not know—the people of Israel. Under whose wings did she take refuge? Was Boaz willing to spread the corner of his garment over Ruth? Why or why not? Whose grandfather was the son of Boaz and Ruth? Both being Moabite women, what is the difference between Ruth and the woman mentioned in Numbers 25?
zh: 路得說了什麼，使拿俄米知道她定意要跟隨自己歸回以色列？ 路得離開父母和本地，到素不認識的以色列民中，是投靠在誰的翅膀下？ 波阿斯是否願意用他的衣襟遮蓋路得，為什麼？ 波阿斯和路得的兒子是誰的祖父？ 同是摩押女子，路得和民數記二十五章的有什麼區別？

en: What did Hannah say in her distress, crying out and praying to the LORD, and what vow did she make? Why did Hannah name her son Samuel? Why were Eli’s two sons guilty of such serious sin in the sight of the LORD? Did Eli restrain them? Could sacrifices atone for the sins of Eli’s house? Which verses in 1 Samuel 3 speak about “revelation”? Why was the Ark of the Covenant captured?
zh: 哈拿心裡愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈禱耶和華，許願說了什麼？ 哈拿為什麼給她兒子起名叫撒母耳？ 以利兩個兒子的罪在耶和華面前甚重，為什麼？ 以利禁止他們了嗎？ 獻祭可以贖去以利家的罪孽嗎？ 撒上第三章有“默示”的經文是哪幾節？ 神的約櫃為何被擄去？

en: Why did the Philistines return the Ark of God to Israel? Why did the LORD strike down seventy men of Beth Shemesh? What stone did Samuel set up between Mizpah and Shen, what did he name it, and what did he say? Israel wanted to appoint a king to govern them because they had rejected whom and did not want whom as their king?
zh: 為什麼非利士人要把以色列神的約櫃送回？ 伯示麥七十人為何被耶和華擊殺？ 撒母耳將一塊石頭立在米斯巴和善的中間，給石頭起名叫什麼，說了什麼？ 以色列要立個王治理他們，因為他們是厭棄誰，不要誰作他們的王？

en: Who brought Saul from the territory of Benjamin to Samuel? How was Saul transformed into a new man? When casting lots to choose Saul as king, where did he hide? Where did the people make Saul king before the LORD? In seeking to appoint a king, against whom did Israel commit a great sin?
zh: 誰使掃羅從便雅憫地到撒母耳這裡來？ 掃羅是如何變為新人的？ 抽簽選掃羅作王時，他藏在何處？ 在什麼地方，眾百姓在耶和華面前立掃羅為王？ 以色列人求立王的事是在誰面前犯大罪了？

en: In which year of Saul’s reign did he act foolishly and disobey whose command, and would his throne endure? Was Saul’s oath in 1 Samuel 14 good? Both involved killing enemies—was Joshua’s prayer in chapter 10 better? Obedience is better than what, and submission is better than what? The sin of rebellion is equivalent to what? The sin of stubbornness is equal to what? Who rejected the LORD’s command, and whom did the LORD reject as king? Whom did Samuel anoint as king of Israel in Bethlehem, whose spirit was greatly empowered by the LORD, and from whom did the LORD’s spirit depart?
zh: 掃羅作王第幾年，他做了糊塗事，沒有遵守誰的命令，他的王位會長久嗎？ 撒上14章掃羅叫百姓起的誓好嗎？ 同是擊殺敵人，書10章約書亞的禱告是不是更好？ 聽命勝於什麼，順從勝於什麼？ 悖逆的罪與什麼相等？ 頑梗的罪與什麼相同？ 誰厭棄了耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄誰作王？ 在伯利恆撒母耳膏誰為以色列的王，耶和華的靈大大感動誰？ 而耶和華的靈離開了誰？

en: Goliath challenged Israel for forty days; did anyone face him? What did Goliath rely on to attack David, and what did David rely on to attack Goliath? After David killed Goliath, how did Jonathan treat David, and how did Saul treat David? Whom should we learn from? Saul demanded a hundred Philistine foreskins as a bride price—was he truly willing for David to marry his daughter? After David defeated the Philistines greatly, did Saul want to reward him or kill him? Saul sought to kill David, but who allied with David’s house?
zh: 歌利亞向以色列人討戰四十天，有人迎戰嗎？ 歌利亞攻擊大衛是靠什麼，大衛攻擊歌利亞是靠什麼？ 大衛打死歌利亞後，約拿單如何對待大衛，而掃羅如何對待大衛，我們該向誰學習？ 掃羅要一百非利士人的陽皮作聘禮，是真心想讓大衛作他的女婿嗎？ 大衛大大殺敗非利士人後，掃羅是要獎賞他還是要殺他？ 掃羅要殺大衛，而誰卻與大衛家結盟？

en: Who is mentioned in the New Testament as entering the house of God and eating the consecrated bread? During his flight, did David go to Philistine or Moabite territory? Who commanded his men to kill Ahimelek, the priest of the LORD? Whom did David consult about saving Keilah, and whom did he consult about leaving Keilah to escape Saul? In the cave, David had the opportunity to kill Saul but did not—why? Did Saul know that David would become king of Israel?
zh: 誰曾在新約提到大衛進了神的殿，吃了陳設餅？ 大衛逃亡時，是否去過非利士地和摩押地？ 誰吩咐手下去殺耶和華的祭司亞希米勒？ 對於是否拯救基伊拉，大衛求問了誰？ 對於是否撤離基伊拉躲避掃羅，大衛又求問了誰？ 在洞裡，大衛有機會殺掃羅，但沒殺，為什麼？ 掃羅知道大衛必作以色列的王嗎？

en: David sent his servant to see Nabal—if you were in the same situation, would you respond like Nabal or like Abigail to David? In Saul’s camp, David again had the chance to kill Saul but did not—why? Did Saul know he was guilty? Did David tell Achish that he had invaded Judah—was this true? When Saul inquired of the LORD, did the LORD answer him? Who had cut off the mediums and later sought a medium for inquiry?
zh: 大衛派他的僕人去見拿八，如果你遇到同樣情景，你會像拿八那樣，還是像亞比該那樣回應大衛？ 在掃羅營地，大衛又有機會殺掃羅，但沒殺，為什麼？ 掃羅知道自己有罪嗎？ 大衛對亞吉說他侵犯了猶大地，是真的嗎？ 掃羅求問耶和華，耶和華回答他了嗎？ 誰曾剪除交鬼的，而後又找交鬼的求問？

en: The Philistines gathered at Aphek to fight Israel; did the Philistine commanders allow David to go out with them? Whom did David consult about whether he could pursue the Amalekites? From the spoils David took from the Amalekites, how much did the fighting men and the guards each receive? Saul and his three sons died in battle against whom? Who killed Saul?
zh: 非利士人聚集到亞弗去和以色列打仗，非利士首領讓大衛和他們一同出戰嗎？ 對於是否能追趕上亞瑪力人，大衛求問了誰？ 大衛從亞瑪力人得到的擄物，上陣的和看守的各得多少？ 掃羅和他的三個兒子死於和什麼人的爭戰？ 誰使掃羅被殺？

en: Saul had pursued David for many years. Now that Saul was dead, did David rejoice or mourn and weep? Whether he could go up to Judah, and even which city to go to—whom did David inquire of? Where was David anointed king over the house of Judah? Why did Joab kill Abner? Was it during battle, and was it ordered by King David? Did the two leaders of raiding bands who killed Saul’s son Ish-bosheth receive a reward from David?
zh: 掃羅曾追殺大衛多年，現在掃羅死了，大衛歡喜快樂還是悲哀哭號？ 是否可去猶大，甚至哪一個城，大衛求問了誰？ 在哪裡大衛被膏作猶大家的王？ 約押為什麼要殺押尼珥，是在戰鬥中殺的嗎，是大衛王指使的嗎？ 殺死掃羅兒子伊施波設的兩個軍長得到大衛的賞賜了嗎？

en: How old was David when he became king, and how many years did he reign? Could he attack the Philistines, and whom did David inquire of? Why did the LORD strike Uzzah dead? Did Saul’s daughter Michal bear children for David? In “I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever”, who does “his” refer to? In “I will be his father, and he shall be my son”, who does “he” refer to? Who gave David victory wherever he went?
zh: 大衛登基時多大年紀，在位多少年？ 是否可以攻打非利士人，大衛求問了誰？ 耶和華為什麼擊殺烏撒？ 掃羅的女兒米甲有沒有為大衛生養兒女？ “我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠”裡的他是誰？ “我要作他的父，他要作我的子”裡的他是誰？ 大衛無論往哪裡去，誰都使他得勝？

en: Why did David show kindness to Mephibosheth? Why did David summon Uriah back to Jerusalem? Who killed Uriah? Who despised the LORD’s command？ What evil did he do in the LORD’s sight？ Whom did he give opportunity to blaspheme because of it？ How will the evildoer be punished?
zh: 為什麼大衛施恩與米非波設？ 大衛為什麼召烏利亞回耶路撒冷？ 誰殺死了烏利亞？ 誰藐視了耶和華的命令？ 他行了耶和華眼中看為惡的什麼事？ 為此讓誰大得褻瀆的機會？ 行此惡事的人要被如何報應？

en: Amnon disgraced Tamar, and Absalom killed Amnon—why did such calamity occur in David’s house? According to the law, how should they have been punished? Who arranged for Absalom to return from Geshur to Jerusalem? Why did David flee Jerusalem, yet leave the Ark of God behind? How did David respond to Shimei’s cursing? How did Absalom treat David’s concubines left behind, and whose prophecy did this fulfill?
zh: 暗嫩玷辱了她瑪，押沙龍殺了暗嫩，為何在大衛家有此禍患？ 按照律法，如何懲治他們？ 誰設法讓押沙龍從基述回到耶路撒冷？ 大衛為何逃離耶路撒冷，但留下神的約櫃？ 大衛如何回應示每的咒罵？ 押沙龍如何對待大衛留守的妃嬪，這應驗了誰的話？

en: Why did Absalom and others say that “The advice of Hushai the Arkite is better than that of Ahithophel”? How did Ahithophel die? Who killed Absalom? Even after defeating Absalom and his followers, why did the whole army’s victory turn into mourning? Did David execute Shimei who cursed him? Who divided the land with Sheba? How did Joab kill Amasa? How was the rebel Sheba killed?
zh: 為什麼押沙龍等說“亞基人戶篩的計謀比亞希多弗的計謀更好”？ 亞希多弗是如何死的？ 誰殺死了押沙龍？ 打敗了押沙龍等，但是為什麼眾民得勝的快樂卻變成悲哀？ 大衛是否治死罵他的示每？ 誰與洗巴均分地土？ 約押是如何殺死亞瑪撒的？ 匪徒示巴是如何被殺的？

en: Why was there a famine for three successive years during David’s reign? In which book of the Bible did Israel swear not to destroy the Gibeonites? In David’s psalm, who is his fortress, rock, stronghold, shield, horn of salvation, high tower, refuge, light in darkness, and strength? In 2 Samuel 23:3–7, whose Spirit spoke through David? Who made an everlasting covenant with the house of David? Why did David refuse to drink the water three mighty warriors drew from the well by the gate of Bethlehem? Why did David conduct a census of the people of Israel and Judah? When faced with the three judgments the LORD would bring, how did David choose?
zh: 大衛年間為何有連續三年的飢荒？ 在聖經哪部書以色列曾起誓不殺滅基遍人？ 在大衛的詩裡，誰是他的山寨，磐石，盾牌，拯救的角，高台，避難所，照明黑暗的燈，堅固的保障？ 撒下23：3—7是誰的靈藉著大衛說的？ 誰與大衛家立永遠的約？ 大衛為什麼不肯喝三個勇士從伯利恆城門旁井裡打來的水？ 大衛為什麼要數點以色列人和猶大人？ 面對耶和華要降的三樣災，大衛如何選擇？

en: Who said, “I will be king,” and who was anointed to succeed David as king? What did David instruct Solomon to observe, in whose obedience was he to walk, and what decrees and laws was he to keep so that he would prosper in all he did and wherever he went? By chapter 4, how many of David’s sons had been killed? Abiathar was prevented from serving as priest, fulfilling whose words in which book of the Bible? Why was Joab killed? Who, even though grasping the horns of the altar, was still killed? What did Solomon ask of the LORD that pleased Him? Whose wisdom did Solomon possess in his heart to judge? Can Solomon’s wisdom be measured?

For whose name did Solomon resolve to build the temple? Who provided him with cedar and juniper log according to Solomon’s specifications? In which year did construction of the LORD’s temple begin, and how long did it take to complete? Regarding the temple Solomon built, what message from the LORD came to him? Before which festival did the priests carry the Ark of the LORD into the inner sanctuary? What was inside the Ark? What filled the LORD’s temple? Who fulfilled the promises made to David, speaking them personally and accomplishing them by hand? Did the LORD’s promises to bless, given through His servant Moses, fail?

Is it possible for the LORD to abandon and disregard His temple, and if so, under what conditions? Regarding Solomon’s wisdom, was there a difference between what the Queen of Sheba heard and what she saw with her own eyes? Whom did she say is to be praised? Who in the New Testament mentions the Queen of Sheba coming to hear Solomon’s wisdom? Why did the LORD take the kingdom from Solomon and give ten tribes to Jeroboam? How many years did Solomon reign over Israel? Why did Rehoboam refuse to listen to the people? What did Jeroboam make for the people to worship, and in history, when did Israel also worship in a similar way?

What did the man of God from Judah proclaim to the altar by the command of the LORD, and why was he killed by a lion on his way back? Among the family of Jeroboam, who alone was buried in a grave, and why? What happened to the rest, and why? Except for what matter, did David do everything that was right in the eyes of the LORD and never disobey His commands? Who killed all of Jeroboam’s household, fulfilling the LORD’s word, and what was the fate of his family, and why? How did King Ahab of Israel do evil in the eyes of the LORD compared to previous kings?

Who caused the drought in Israel, and how long did it last? Regarding Elijah’s prayer, how is it described in the New Testament? Who in the New Testament mentions the widow of Zarephath in Sidon? On Mount Horeb, what question did the LORD ask Elijah, how many times, did he answer the same each time, and what did the LORD say to him afterward? Ahab released Ben-Hadad; how did the LORD intend to deal with Ahab?

Why did Naboth refuse to sell his vineyard to Ahab? Was Naboth killed for blaspheming God? Who betrayed Ahab? What was the fate of Ahab’s family? Regarding the capture of Ramoth-gilead, Ahab gathered about four hundred men—were they prophets of the LORD? Who was the true prophet of the LORD? How did Ahab die, and did the LORD’s word come to pass? Whom did Ahab marry, who supported the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who killed the LORD’s prophets and pursued Elijah, and who ordered Naboth’s death? What was her fate?

Why would Ahaziah not recover from the bed he lay on, and why was he certain to die? Why was the third captain with his fifty men not consumed by the fire sent from heaven? By whom, in what manner was Elijah taken, and to where? Before Elijah was taken, what request did Elisha made of him? What miracles did Elisha perform in these four chapters?

Who advised Naaman of Aram to go to Samaria to be healed of leprosy? Did the king of Israel have a way to heal him? What was the method of healing provided by the man of God, Elisha? Did Naaman accept it at first? Later, after whose advice did he follow Elisha’s instructions, and was he cleansed? When Naaman returned to the man of God, what did he now know, what did he request Elisha to give him, what did he intend to use it for, and what did he ask the LORD to forgive him for? During Elisha’s time, were any lepers in Israel cleansed? Elisha did not accept Naaman’s gift. Who, however, pursued Naaman to demand a gift, and as a result, he and his descendants were afflicted with Naaman’s leprosy? When Elisha was besieged in Dothan by the Aramean army, what did he say to his servant who did not know what to do? Where in the Bible was it prophesied that they would eat their own children, and whose fault was this disaster? Who would see it with their own eyes but not eat it, and why? Upon whom did Elisha fix his gaze and cry, and why? Who married Ahab’s daughter and did evil in the eyes of the LORD?

Whom did Elisha’s disciples anoint as king of Israel, and what did the LORD commission this king to do? Which king did Jehu kill along with King Jehoram of Israel? How was Jezebel killed, what happened to Ahab’s seventy sons, was all of Ahab’s house destroyed, and was the LORD’s word spoken through Elijah fulfilled? Were the Baal worshippers killed? Did Jehu fully obey the law of the LORD? How was the northern kingdom of Israel reduced? Who overthrew the royal family of Judah, reigned for six years, and whose daughter was she? Who saved Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and where was he hidden? On whom did Jehoiada place a crown, to him did he give the book of the law, and whom did he anointed as king? Who made the king and the people enter into a covenant with the LORD, making them the LORD’s people, and also made a covenant between the king and the people? How old was Joash when he became king, how many years did he reign, and did he do what was right in the eyes of the LORD?

King Hazael of Aram repeatedly oppressed Israel. Do you remember the prophecy concerning his oppression? Why was Elisha angry with Joash? King Amaziah of Judah killed the servants who had murdered his father but did not kill their children. Why, and in which book of the law is this commanded? Whom did the LORD provide as a savior for Israel to deliver them from the hands of the Arameans, and why? How many generations would Jehu’s descendants sit on Israel’s throne, and was the LORD’s word fulfilled? During King Pekah’s reign, who captured what regions and deported their inhabitants to Assyria? Which king of Judah reigned when the Aramean king and the king of Israel came up to attack Jerusalem? Which king of Judah worshiped the idols of Damascus?

Who was the last king of Israel, and how many years did he reign? Who captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria? Why were Israel exiled — whom did they sin against, whom did they disobey, whose anger did they provoke, in whom did they not believe, whose statutes and what covenant did they reject, whose commandments did they forsake, and in whose eyes did they do evil? Which peoples were resettled in Israel, and what else did they worship alongside their fear of the LORD? In which year of Hezekiah’s reign was Israel exiled to Assyria? When King Sennacherib of Assyria sent envoys to mock the LORD, how many were killed by the LORD’s angel in the Assyrian camp, and where did Sennacherib die? Did Hezekiah ask for the shadow to move forward or backward, and do you remember which book records the sun standing still for a day? After the Babylonian envoys departed, what did Isaiah say to Hezekiah?

Manasseh did evil in the eyes of the LORD even more than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before Israel. What did he build in the courts of the LORD’s temple, and what did he set up inside the temple? Upon whom the LORD said He would bring disaster, with what measuring line and plumb line would be stretched over which place, what would be wiped out, and whom would He reject, and why? When High Priest Hilkiah found the Book of the Law in the temple, was it the first time he and King Josiah learned its contents? How did the king react in his heart? Before whom did he humble himself, what did he tear, and to whom did he cry? What did the LORD grant him? Which book instructs the king to make a copy of the law for himself? Do you remember what the LORD told the man of God to say to Jeroboam, and was it fulfilled? From when until Josiah’s eighteenth year, was there truly no one like him who observed the Passover to the LORD? Before and after Josiah, was there any king who turned to the LORD with all his heart, soul, and strength like him? In which year of the Babylonian king’s reign did this happen — what did he carry away, what did he destroy, and just as had been foretold by whom? Who was the last king of Judah, in which year of his reign was Jerusalem captured? In what year, month, and day of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon was the LORD’s temple burned with fire?
